anchors.identity_uncertainty: Identified as a standard sleeping pillow from its elongated rectangular shape and pillowcase-like trim; if it is a decorative cushion, a folded throw, or a non-standard (e.g. 26x26 in) size, the long side could differ by roughly -15% to +10%.
